{"findings":[{"location":"HTML, stanza 1","severity":"major","source_quote":"The early church in olden days / Had a desire to tell / The sinner about Jesus Christ","suggested_fix":"Replace the stanza text with: \"Kanisa la kwanza siku za kale
lilitamani kuwaambia
wadhambi kuhusu Yesu Kristo,

Licha ya hatari na upanga.\"","translation_quote":"Na wakajitahidi kutii amri hii / Licha ya hatari na upanga."},{"location":"HTML, stanza 4","severity":"major","source_quote":"A lot of folks were burned at stake","suggested_fix":"Replace “Watu wengi walichomwa kwenye mti wa mateso” with “Watu wengi walichomwa kwenye mti wa kuchomea.”","translation_quote":"Watu wengi walichomwa kwenye mti wa mateso"},{"location":"HTML, stanza 8","severity":"major","source_quote":"Since faith is good, why don’t we share / As did the saints of old?","suggested_fix":"Replace the last two lines with: \"Kwa kuwa imani ni njema, kwa nini tusishiriki
Kama walivyofanya watakatifu wa zamani?\"","translation_quote":"Kwa kuwa imani ni njema, kwa nini hatuishiriki / Kama watakatifu wa zamani?"},{"location":"HTML, stanza 9","severity":"major","source_quote":"And vigorous in fight.","suggested_fix":"Replace “Na wanapambana kwa nguvu” with “Na wana juhudi kubwa katika mapambano.”","translation_quote":"Na wanapambana kwa nguvu."},{"location":"HTML, stanza 10","severity":"major","source_quote":"They praise their Lord on high. / And thank Him that for Jesus’ sake","suggested_fix":"Replace “Wao wanamsifu Bwana wao aliye juu. / Na wanamshukuru kwamba kwa ajili ya Yesu” with “Wao wanamsifu Bwana wao aliye juu, / na wanamshukuru kwamba kwa ajili ya Yesu Kristo”.","translation_quote":"Wao wanamsifu Bwana wao aliye juu. / Na wanamshukuru kwamba kwa ajili ya Yesu"},{"location":"HTML, stanza 11","severity":"major","source_quote":"If we would also spread God’s Word, / Our blood would stain our sod.","suggested_fix":"Replace the last two lines with: \"Ikiwa sisi pia tungeeneza Neno la Mungu,
Damu yetu ingeitia doa ardhi yetu.\"","translation_quote":"Ikiwa sisi pia tutaeneza Neno la Mungu, / Damu yetu itatia doa ardhi yetu."},{"location":"HTML, stanza 13","severity":"major","source_quote":"If we don’t bring the folks to God, / The populace will die.","suggested_fix":"Replace “Tusipowaleta watu kwa Mungu, / Wananchi watakufa” with “Tusipowaleta watu kwa Mungu, / watu wengi watakufa.”","translation_quote":"Tusipowaleta watu kwa Mungu, / Wananchi watakufa."},{"location":"HTML, stanza 14","severity":"major","source_quote":"Showing lost souls, the narrow way, / That leads men home to God.","suggested_fix":"Replace the last two lines with: \"Tukiwaonyesha roho zilizopotea njia nyembamba,
inayowaongoza watu kurudi nyumbani kwa Mungu.\"","translation_quote":"Tukiwaonyesha waliopotea njia nyembamba, / Inayowaongoza watu nyumbani kwa Mungu."}],"passed":false,"score":76}
